text.en: I think crossing over is a rare error that occasionally happens during cell division, rather than a normal, expected part of every meiosis -- in reality, crossing over is a routine, essential step of meiosis I that occurs in virtually every meiotic division, not a rare mistake; it is one of the two main mechanisms, along with independent assortment, that generates the genetic diversity meiosis exists to produce.
text.et: Arvan, et ületõmbumine on harv viga, mis rakujagunemise ajal aeg-ajalt juhtub, mitte normaalne, oodatav osa igast meioosist -- tegelikult on ületõmbumine rutiinne, hädavajalik meioos I etapp, mis toimub praktiliselt igas meiootilises jagunemises, mitte harv eksitus; see on koos sõltumatu jaotumisega üks kahest peamisest mehhanismist, mis loob geneetilise mitmekesisuse, mille loomiseks meioos olemas on.
